passages.text: Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury, and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.
passages.sermon:
Jesus was present with His disciples and the people.
Jesus looked up.
Jesus saw rich people.
The rich people put their gifts into the temple treasury.
Jesus also saw a widow.
The widow was poor.
The poor widow put two small copper coins into the treasury.
passages.original: Ἀναβλέψας δὲ εἶδεν τοὺς βάλλοντας εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον τὰ δῶρα αὐτῶν πλουσίους εἶδεν δέ τινα χήραν πενιχρὰν βάλλουσαν ἐκεῖ λεπτὰ δύο

passages.text: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the people.
He said, “I tell you the truth.”
He pointed to a poor widow.
He said, “This poor widow has given more than all the others.”
passages.original: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ χήρα αὕτη ἡ πτωχὴ πλεῖον πάντων ἔβαλεν

passages.text: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus saw people giving gifts to the temple treasury.
Many rich people gave from their extra wealth.
They gave what they did not need.
A poor widow also gave a gift.
She was very poor.
She gave out of her poverty.
She gave all she had to live on.
She gave everything she had.
passages.original: πάντες γὰρ οὗτοι ἐκ τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς ἔβαλον εἰς τὰ δῶρα αὕτη δὲ ἐκ τοῦ ὑστερήματος αὐτῆς πάντα τὸν βίον ὃν εἶχεν ἔβαλεν

passages.text: As some of the disciples were remarking how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts, Jesus said, “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
passages.sermon:
Some of Jesus’ disciples spoke about the temple.
They said the temple was decorated with beautiful stones.
They also said the temple had consecrated gifts.
Jesus listened to them.
Jesus spoke to them about the temple.
Jesus said, “You see these things here.
A time will come.
In that time, not one stone will stay on another.
Every stone will be thrown down.”
passages.original: Καί τινων λεγόντων περὶ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ὅτι λίθοις καλοῖς καὶ ἀναθήμασιν κεκόσμηται εἶπεν Ταῦτα ἃ θεωρεῖτε ἐλεύσονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται λίθος ἐπὶ λίθῳ ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται

passages.text: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
passages.sermon:
Some people spoke to Jesus.
They called Him Teacher.
They asked Jesus a question.
They said, “When will these things happen?”
They also asked, “What will be the sign?”
They wanted to know the sign that these things are about to take place.
passages.original: Ἐπηρώτησαν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγοντες Διδάσκαλε πότε οὖν ταῦτα ἔσται καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα γίνεσθαι

passages.text: Jesus answered, “See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them.
He said, “Be careful.
Do not let anyone deceive you.
Many people will come.
They will use My name.
They will say, ‘I am He.’
They will say, ‘The time is near.’
Do not follow them.”
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Βλέπετε μὴ πλανηθῆτε πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες Ἐγώ εἰμι καί Ὁ καιρὸς ἤγγικεν μὴ πορευθῆτε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

passages.text: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the future.
He said, “You will hear about wars.
You will hear about rebellions.
Do not be afraid.
These things must happen first.
The end will not come right away.”
passages.original: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκαταστασίας μὴ πτοηθῆτε δεῖ γὰρ ταῦτα γενέσθαι πρῶτον ἀλλ’ οὐκ εὐθέως τὸ τέλος

passages.text: Then He told them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the future.
He said, “Nation will rise against nation.
Kingdom will rise against kingdom.”
passages.original: Τότε ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἐγερθήσεται ἔθνος ἐπ’ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν

passages.text: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the future.
There will be great earthquakes.
There will be famines in different places.
There will be pestilences in different places.
People will see fearful sights.
There will be great signs from heaven.
passages.original: σεισμοί τε μεγάλοι καὶ κατὰ τόπους λιμοὶ καὶ λοιμοὶ ἔσονται φόβητρά τε καὶ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ σημεῖα μεγάλα ἔσται

passages.text: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about coming troubles.
Before the great disasters happen, people will seize you.
They will lay their hands on you.
They will persecute you.
They will arrest you because you follow Me.
They will deliver you to the synagogues.
They will put you in prisons.
They will bring you before kings.
They will bring you before governors.
They will do all this because of My name.
passages.original: Πρὸ δὲ τούτων πάντων ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ διώξουσιν παραδιδόντες εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ φυλακάς ἀπαγομένους ἐπὶ βασιλεῖς καὶ ἡγεμόνας ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου

passages.text: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His followers.
He warned them about coming troubles.
He said people would seize and persecute them because of His name.
They would be brought before synagogues, prisons, kings, and governors.
Jesus said these events would become an opportunity for them.
They would serve as witnesses during these times.
passages.original: ἀποβήσεται ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον

passages.text: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about coming persecution.
He told them to prepare their hearts.
He said, “Do not plan your defense ahead of time.”
He commanded them not to worry about what to say.
passages.original: θέτε οὖν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν μὴ προμελετᾶν ἀπολογηθῆναι

passages.text: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His followers.
Jesus promised to help them when they face opposition.
He said, “I will give you words to say.”
He said, “I will give you wisdom.”
Your enemies will not be able to resist your words.
Your enemies will not be able to contradict your wisdom.
passages.original: ἐγὼ γὰρ δώσω ὑμῖν στόμα καὶ σοφίαν ᾗ οὐ δυνήσονται ἀντιστῆναι ἢ ἀντειπεῖν ἅπαντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι ὑμῖν

passages.text: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His followers.
He warned them about coming troubles.
People will betray you.
Your parents may betray you.
Your brothers may betray you.
Your relatives may betray you.
Your friends may betray you.
Some of you will be put to death.
passages.original: Παραδοθήσεσθε δὲ καὶ ὑπὸ γονέων καὶ ἀδελφῶν καὶ συγγενῶν καὶ φίλων καὶ θανατώσουσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν

passages.text: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His followers.
He said, "People will hate you."
They will hate you because of My name.
Everyone will hate you for following Me.
passages.original: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου

passages.text: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
\r\nHe warned them about coming persecution.
\r\nHe said, “Not even a hair from your head will be lost.”
\r\nGod will protect you completely.
\r\nYou will not lose even the smallest part of yourself.
passages.original: καὶ θρὶξ ἐκ τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ ἀπόληται

passages.text: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His followers.
He told them about coming troubles.
He said, “People will hate you because of My name.”
He promised, “Not even a hair of your head will perish.”
He gave this command:
Be patient.
Endure.
If you endure with patience, you will gain your souls.
Your patient endurance will save your lives.
passages.original: ἐν τῇ ὑπομονῇ ὑμῶν κτήσασθε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν

passages.text: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
\r\nHe warned them about the future of Jerusalem.
\r\nHe said, "You will see armies surround Jerusalem."
\r\nWhen you see this, you will know something important.
\r\nYou will know that Jerusalem’s destruction is near.
passages.original: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε κυκλουμένην ὑπὸ στρατοπέδων Ἰερουσαλήμ τότε γνῶτε ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ ἐρήμωσις αὐτῆς

passages.text: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples about the coming destruction of Jerusalem.
He warned the people living in Judea.
He told them to flee to the mountains.
He spoke to those inside the city.
He told them to leave the city.
He spoke to those in the countryside.
He told them not to enter the city.
passages.original: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη καὶ οἱ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκχωρείτωσαν καὶ οἱ ἐν ταῖς χώραις μὴ εἰσερχέσθωσαν εἰς αὐτήν

passages.text: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
passages.sermon: These are days of vengeance.\r\nGod will bring justice in these days.\r\nEverything written in Scripture will be fulfilled.
passages.original: ὅτι ἡμέραι ἐκδικήσεως αὗταί εἰσιν τοῦ πλησθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα

passages.text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke about a coming time of great trouble.
He warned the people living in Judea.
He said those days would be very hard for pregnant women.
He said those days would be very hard for mothers nursing babies.
There will be great distress on the land.
God’s anger will come against this people.
passages.original: Οὐαὶ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἔσται γὰρ ἀνάγκη μεγάλη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὀργὴ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ

passages.text: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
passages.sermon:
Many people in Jerusalem will die by the sword.
Enemies will kill them.
Others will become captives.
Their enemies will take them away to every nation.
Gentiles will control Jerusalem.
They will trample the city.
This will continue until the time for the Gentiles is complete.
passages.original: καὶ πεσοῦνται στόματι μαχαίρης καὶ αἰχμαλωτισθήσονται εἰς τὰ ἔθνη πάντα καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἔσται πατουμένη ὑπὸ ἐθνῶν ἄχρι οὗ πληρωθῶσιν καιροὶ ἐθνῶν

passages.text: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples about the end times.
He said there will be signs in the sun.
There will be signs in the moon.
There will be signs in the stars.
On the earth, the nations will be in distress.
The nations will be confused and troubled.
They will hear the roaring of the sea.
They will see the surging of the waves.
The people will not understand what is happening.
passages.original: Καὶ ἔσονται σημεῖα ἐν ἡλίῳ καὶ σελήνῃ καὶ ἄστροις καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συνοχὴ ἐθνῶν ἐν ἀπορίᾳ ἤχους θαλάσσης καὶ σάλου

passages.text: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
passages.sermon:
Men will faint.
They will be afraid.
They will feel anxiety about what is coming on the earth.
The powers of the heavens will be shaken.
passages.original: ἀποψυχόντων ἀνθρώπων ἀπὸ φόβου καὶ προσδοκίας τῶν ἐπερχομένων τῇ οἰκουμένῃ αἱ γὰρ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται

passages.text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of Man.
At that time, people will see Jesus.
Jesus will come in a cloud.
Jesus will come with power.
Jesus will come with great glory.
passages.original: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλῃ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς

passages.text: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to his disciples.
He warned them about fearful events coming upon the earth.
He said, “When these things begin to happen, stand up.
Lift up your heads.
Your redemption is drawing near.”
passages.original: ἀρχομένων δὲ τούτων γίνεσθαι ἀνακύψατε καὶ ἐπάρατε τὰς κεφαλὰς ὑμῶν διότι ἐγγίζει ἡ ἀπολύτρωσις ὑμῶν

passages.text: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the people.
Jesus told them a parable.
He said, "Look at the fig tree.
Look at all the trees."
passages.original: Καὶ εἶπεν παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς Ἴδετε τὴν συκῆν καὶ πάντα τὰ δένδρα

passages.text: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He gave them a parable.
He said, “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
When the trees begin to sprout leaves, you can see this for yourselves.
You know that summer is near when you see the leaves appear.”
passages.original: ὅταν προβάλωσιν ἤδη βλέποντες ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν γινώσκετε ὅτι ἤδη ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν

passages.text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He told them a parable.
He said, “You will see certain things happen.
When you see these things, understand this.
The kingdom of God is near.”
passages.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
\r\nJesus said, “Truly, I tell you this.”
\r\nThis generation will not pass away.
\r\nAll these things will happen first.
passages.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται

passages.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is speaking.
He says, "Heaven will pass away.
Earth will pass away.
My words will never pass away."
passages.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται

passages.text: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about the future.
He said, “Watch yourselves.
Do not let your hearts become heavy.
Dissipation can weigh down your heart.
Drunkenness can weigh down your heart.
The worries of life can weigh down your heart.
If you are not careful, that day will come upon you suddenly.
That day will come like a trap.”
passages.original: Προσέχετε δὲ ἑαυτοῖς μή‿ ποτε βαρηθῶσιν ὑμῶν αἱ καρδίαι ἐν κραιπάλῃ καὶ μέθῃ καὶ μερίμναις βιωτικαῖς καὶ ἐπιστῇ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς αἰφνίδιος ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη ὡς παγίς

passages.text: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
passages.sermon: This event will come.\r\nIt will come upon all people.\r\nAll people live on the face of the whole earth.
passages.original: ἐπεισελεύσεται γὰρ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς

passages.text: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
He warned them about coming troubles.
He told them to stay alert at all times.
He told them to pray continually.
He said they should pray for strength.
He said they would need strength to escape everything that is about to happen.
He said they should pray to stand before the Son of Man.
passages.original: ἀγρυπνεῖτε δὲ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ δεόμενοι ἵνα κατισχύσητε ἐκφυγεῖν ταῦτα πάντα τὰ μέλλοντα γίνεσθαι καὶ σταθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου

passages.text: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
passages.sermon: Jesus taught at the temple every day.\r\nHe went out every evening.\r\nHe spent the night on the Mount of Olives.
passages.original: Ἦν δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων τὰς δὲ νύκτας ἐξερχόμενος ηὐλίζετο εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν

passages.text: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.
passages.sermon: Jesus taught at the temple.\r\nAll the people came to Him early in the morning.\r\nThey came to the temple to hear Him.
passages.original: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὤρθριζεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ
